cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.18)
project(vcmi_vita_iconv C)
file(GLOB_RECURSE ICONV_SOURCES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS src/*.c)
add_library(vcmi_vita_iconv STATIC ${ICONV_SOURCES})
target_compile_definitions(vcmi_vita_iconv PRIVATE
_ICONV_FROM_ENCODING_WIN_1250 _ICONV_TO_ENCODING_WIN_1250
_ICONV_FROM_ENCODING_WIN_1251 _ICONV_TO_ENCODING_WIN_1251
_ICONV_FROM_ENCODING_WIN_1252 _ICONV_TO_ENCODING_WIN_1252
_ICONV_FROM_ENCODING_WIN_1253 _ICONV_TO_ENCODING_WIN_1253
_ICONV_FROM_ENCODING_WIN_1254 _ICONV_TO_ENCODING_WIN_1254
_ICONV_FROM_ENCODING_WIN_1255 _ICONV_TO_ENCODING_WIN_1255
_ICONV_FROM_ENCODING_WIN_1256 _ICONV_TO_ENCODING_WIN_1256
_ICONV_FROM_ENCODING_WIN_1257 _ICONV_TO_ENCODING_WIN_1257
_ICONV_FROM_ENCODING_WIN_1258 _ICONV_TO_ENCODING_WIN_1258
_ICONV_FROM_ENCODING_UTF_8 _ICONV_TO_ENCODING_UTF_8
_ICONV_FROM_ENCODING_UTF_16 _ICONV_TO_ENCODING_UTF_16
_ICONV_FROM_ENCODING_UCS_2_INTERNAL _ICONV_TO_ENCODING_UCS_2_INTERNAL
_ICONV_FROM_ENCODING_UCS_4_INTERNAL _ICONV_TO_ENCODING_UCS_4_INTERNAL
_ICONV_FROM_ENCODING_US_ASCII _ICONV_TO_ENCODING_US_ASCII
_ICONV_FROM_ENCODING_ISO_8859_1 _ICONV_TO_ENCODING_ISO_8859_1
_ICONV_FROM_ENCODING_ISO_8859_2 _ICONV_TO_ENCODING_ISO_8859_2)
